purpose: Teach: 発泡/源流/ソプラノ/ジェンダーフリー/右腕/語尾/踏切/出走

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、発泡素材の医療機器を医療チームで導入します
lines.en: Ren, we're going to introduce foam-based medical equipment across the team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Measured pace. Direct eye contact. The tone of someone delivering necessary information without urgency or alarm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染症の源流追跡を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes, we're advancing our infection source tracing protocols as a team.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Slight warmth underneath the clinical language. Unhurried, like she's already thought through the steps. Professional reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ソプラノ歌手の声帯検診を、貴院、おこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: Doctor, I noticed your hospital does vocal cord screenings for soprano singers, don't you?
lines.style: Respectful curiosity, not quite confident. Slight pause before the question. Shows he's been thinking about this. Genuinely interested in her answer, not performing knowledge.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ジェンダーフリーな医療相談を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes, we provide gender-inclusive medical consultations across the team.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement delivered with quiet conviction. No defensiveness, no performance. Just stating what they do. Steady voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の右腕の血圧測定を医療チームで標準化します
lines.en: Ren, we're standardizing blood pressure measurements on the right arm across the team.
lines.style: Same clinical clarity as the opening. Specific detail delivered without ceremony. Professional confidence. Brief, because the task is straightforward.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の語尾の不明瞭さを医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Yes, we're monitoring for speech clarity issues in our patients as a team practice.
lines.style: Calm continuation. Gentle attention to detail. Not clinical-cold—there's care underneath the procedure. The voice of someone who notices small things about her patients.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 踏切事故の救急搬送を、貴院、対応されますね、先生
lines.en: Doctor, your hospital handles emergency transport for railway accidents, correct?
lines.style: Another respectful question, slightly more confident this time. Testing whether he's understood her role. Genuine deference mixed with emerging respect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、競馬関係者の出走前救護も医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we also provide pre-race medical support for horse racing personnel as part of our team responsibilities.
lines.style: Unflustered expansion of scope. Matter-of-fact about the breadth of their work. No pride, no apology. Just stating what they do. Steady throughout.
